name: katalon-testing-skills
description: Agent-neutral AI testing skills for Katalon True Platform covering the full software testing lifecycle: test planning, test design, test management and requirement traceability, test review, manual and automated execution with AI, failure analysis and release readiness, and test maintenance - operated through the Katalon MCP.
author: katalon-labs
highlights: 18 lifecycle skills - plan, design, manage, review, execute, and maintain - the agent selects by intent
Operates your real Katalon True Platform workspace through the Katalon MCP, not a mock
Turn a requirement into linked manual cases, then run them with Run-with-AI
Convert manual cases to Playwright TypeScript or Katalon Studio Groovy
Upload and verify Katalon Studio/KRE, JUnit XML, and Playwright reports, then answer 'is this release safe to ship?'
Browser-OAuth auth only - no tokens or keys pasted into chat; each skill enforces this
